title: Elements Luxury Living — Luxury Is Subjective

rate.rhythm: settling — shots open out from ~1.5s to ~2.5s; it lands and holds

vocabulary: locked wide with the subject moving inside it

lens_set: one low ultra-wide for the pop room
optics.dof: mostly deep for the interiors so the whole space reads; shallow on the detail inserts (shoes, hands, bow tie, teacup)
optics.angle_bias: eye-level to slightly low; strong central symmetry favoured; one dramatic low ultra-wide for the pop-room dance
composition: let the architecture frame the subject (arches, columns, doorways, the lift box)
leave negative space early for the on-screen serif word
make the subject small inside a large, richly-dressed volume

shape.hook_promise: we will redefine what luxury means — and it will surprise you
shape.structure: anaphora montage — a chain of 'it's…' vignettes escalating to a brand reveal
device: every space is aspirational, impossibly clean and fully styled
reality bends for the fantasy — a moon-floor lounge, a giant teapot shower, a pet cheetah indoors
one 'owner' character inhabits each hero space
the brand's argument (luxury = personal) overrides physical logic

match_cuts: the gold/mustard-yellow accent is carried across cuts as the visual glue
the on-screen gold serif word (LUXURY? → IT'S SUBJECTIVE → SUBJECTIVE) links the first three shots

voice.presence: wall-to-wall — one continuous voiced take covering ~86% of the runtime (first word 0.0s, last 49.6s)
voice.pause_style: no measured silence between the first and last word — the delivery never stops for breath; inter-line beats sit ~0.9-1.5s (longest 1.47s)
voice.style: conversational, playful and fragmentary — a running list of definitions of luxury

sources.sizes: counted off the shot rows (measured cuts)
sources.moves: MEASURED — optical flow over the source video, decoded once at 12fps and bucketed by the cut map
sources.optics: read (film-level prose only — no per-shot focal lengths yet)
sources.cutting: measured (beats from the audio, cuts from ffmpeg)

warnings: No per-shot lens_mm — the shot list's Lens column has nothing to fill it.
